steps.u: Support agents want to snooze a ticket until a time of their choosing, and have it reappear in their inbox then. Rails app. Keep it simple.

i.content:
class AddSnoozedUntilToTickets < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.1]
  def change
    add_column :tickets, :snoozed_until, :datetime
    add_index :tickets, :snoozed_until, where: 'snoozed_until IS NOT NULL'
  end
end

i.new_string:
scope :inbox, -> { where(status: :open).where('snoozed_until IS NULL OR snoozed_until <= ?', Time.current) }
  def snooze!(until_time) = update!(snoozed_until: until_time)

i.content:
RSpec.describe Ticket do
  it 'hides a snoozed ticket until its time' do
    t = create(:ticket, status: :open); t.snooze!(1.hour.from_now)
    expect(Ticket.inbox).not_to include(t)
    travel_to(2.hours.from_now) { expect(Ticket.inbox).to include(t) }
  end
end

steps.a: Snoozing is implemented as a timestamp that the inbox scope checks, so no background job is needed: the ticket simply starts matching again when the time passes. The UI button and the controller action are not built yet.

reference.summary: Added ticket snoozing to the Rails helpdesk: a snoozed_until column with a partial index, a snooze! method, and an inbox scope that hides tickets until their time, covered by a model spec that passes. It avoids a background job; the controller action and the button are not built yet.
facts: migration adds snoozed_until with a partial index
inbox scope excludes snoozed tickets until the time passes

decisions.choice: filter on a snoozed_until timestamp in the inbox scope instead of a scheduled job that wakes tickets
decisions.reason: no job to fail or schedule, the ticket reappears by itself when the time passes
